inclusions.text: Airport transfer and hotel check-in on arrival
inclusions.source: Airport transfer, hotel check-in, and a gentle introduction to Cairo's atmosphere — the city is loud, layered, and not best met after a long flight.

inclusions.text: Sleeper train Luxor–Cairo, private cabin with two berths, dinner and breakfast on board
inclusions.source: In the evening, the transfer is to Luxor railway station for the sleeper train back to Cairo — a private cabin with two berths, dinner and breakfast served on board, the Nile valley moving past the window through the night.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.source: Day one is given to arrival.

itinerary.title: Memphis, Saqqara, Coptic quarter, Citadel
itinerary.source: The second day reaches south of the city to where pyramid-building began.

itinerary.title: Desert highway north to Alexandria
itinerary.source: You return to Cairo in the evening.

itinerary.title: Morning flight to Aswan
itinerary.source: A morning flight on day four carries you to Aswan — the southernmost major city of Egypt, with golden light, granite outcrops, Nubian culture, and a calm Nile after the urgency of Cairo.

itinerary.title: The road to Abu Simbel
itinerary.source: After the visit, the drive returns to Aswan for a restful evening.

itinerary.title: Travelling day from Aswan to Luxor
itinerary.source: Day six is a travelling day.

itinerary.title: Hot air balloon over the West Bank
itinerary.source: The seventh day starts before dawn with a hot air balloon over the West Bank.

itinerary.title: East Bank and sleeper train
itinerary.source: In the evening, the transfer is to Luxor railway station for the sleeper train back to Cairo — a private cabin with two berths, dinner and breakfast served on board, the Nile valley moving past the window through the night.

itinerary.title: Giza, Egyptian Museum, Khan el-Khalili
itinerary.source: The ninth day is the closing chapter, and it is a long, charged one.

itinerary.title: Airport transfer for departure flight
itinerary.source: The final day, day ten, is the airport transfer for the departure flight.
